items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Yeah, I played with Bill Gallaty.

ctx.x: You didn't play with him. Do you remember the Gallagher band?
Bill Gallaty? Yeah, I know. He's a triangle player, too. But I never really played. He didn't have a band. He played with different bands. With different bands.

I was going to ask a little bit more about your family. You say your grandfather gave your father this violin that we have. I think so. He came from your grandfather. Yeah, I think it comes from all...
